description: Read Obsidian Cherry's current on-chain state: the redeem price and buy price (both in USD per token, as decimal strings), the reserve's ratio to what the $0.01 floor requires (disclosed as a ratio only — never an absolute reserve or supply amount, decision 28), the floor price, and whether an external reserve shortfall (e.g. the stablecoin issuer freezing funds) is currently open. 503 if Obsidian Cherry isn't configured on this environment yet.
name: obsidian_state
